title: Warehouse peak week rota, w/c 23 November 2026

constraints.rationale: Each line of each shift gets exactly its headcount.

provenance.quote: shifts and headcount per line are in peak_week_shifts.csv

constraints.rationale: FLT lines need a counterbalance licence in the licences column; a reach licence alone does not count, and picking lines have no requirement.

provenance.quote: Only people with a counterbalance licence (licences column) go on an FLT line.

constraints.rationale: Nobody works the picking line and the FLT line of the same shift.

provenance.quote: Obviously nobody can be on both lines at once.

constraints.rationale: Preferably no more than forty hours this week for anyone.

provenance.quote: Ideally nobody goes over forty hours this week.

constraints.rationale: Preferably twelve hours between the end of one shift and the start of the next (no late into early).

provenance.quote: If you can, leave twelve hours between someone's shifts.

constraints.rationale: Kasia is on booked holiday on Thursday 26 and Friday 27 November.

provenance.quote: Kasia is on booked holiday Thursday and Friday. Can't be moved.

constraints.rationale: Dev would rather not work night shifts.

provenance.quote: Dev would rather not do nights

assumptions.text: Kasia's holiday covers the whole of Thursday and Friday (26 Nov 00:00 to 28 Nov 00:00), so the Wednesday night shift that runs into Thursday is excluded too.
Weekly hours are counted from the scheduled start and end of each shift; breaks are not deducted.
